summary: The Owl gives Grisha the Attack Titan and a mission: take the Founding power from the king inside the walls. Eren inherits both the power and the order.

segments.ja: あの日の続きで、フクロウはマーレの官吏の顔を外します。外した顔の名は、クルーガーです。クルーガーは、エルディアの復権を壁の内側まで運ぶ役です。運ぶために、彼は自分の残り時間をグリシャに渡します。渡す時間が、進撃の巨人です。進撃の巨人は、前へ進むことをやめない力として書かれています。書かれた力を、父は壁の中へ持って入ります。入る前に、使命の文面が渡されます。
segments.en: In the continuation of that day, the Owl takes off the face of a Marley official. The name of the face he took off is Kruger. Kruger is the role that carries Eldia's restoration as far as the inside of the walls. In order to carry it, he hands Grisha his own remaining time. The time he hands is the Attack Titan. The Attack Titan is written as a power that does not stop moving forward. The father takes the power that is written and enters the walls. Before he enters, the wording of the mission is handed over.

segments.ja: クルーガーが渡す文面は、壁の中の王から始祖の力を取り戻せ、です。取り戻せ、の相手は、レイスの血です。血の力を、座標とも呼びます。座標は、すべての巨人を一つの意思に結ぶ力として、本にあります。ある力を、壁の王は戦わないことに使ってきました。使ってきた拒否を、フクロウは罪として見ます。見る罪を、グリシャが代わりに犯すよう命じられます。命じられる夜が、マリア陥落の夜へつながります。
segments.en: The wording Kruger hands over is: take back the Founding power from the king inside the walls. The opponent of take back is the Reiss blood. The power of the blood is also called the coordinate. The coordinate is in the book as a power that ties every Titan to one will. The king of the walls has used the power that is there for not fighting. The Owl sees the refusal he has used as a sin. Grisha is ordered to commit, in his place, the sin he sees. The night he is ordered connects to the night Wall Maria falls.

segments.ja: 進撃の巨人の特徴は、硬質化でも、装甲でもありません。ありません。後継へ記憶と意志を渡し、前の世代の前進をやめさせない、です。やめさせない力が、クルーガーからグリシャへ、グリシャからエレンへ続いています。続いていることを、エレンは本を読むまで知りません。知らなかった自分の巨人が、実験の失敗の体と同じ力です。同じ力に、使命の文面が付着しています。付着した文面を、彼は父の声として後で聞きます。
segments.en: The trait of the Attack Titan is not hardening, and it is not armor. It is not. It is handing memory and will to the heir, and not letting the previous generation's advance stop. The power that does not let it stop continues from Kruger to Grisha, and from Grisha to Eren. Eren does not know the continuing until he reads the book. The Titan of himself that he did not know is the same power as the body of the failed experiment. The wording of the mission is attached to the same power. He hears later the attached wording as his father's voice.

segments.ja: 巨人の力には、期限があります。ある期限を、本はおおよそ十三年と示唆します。示唆する期限が、クルーガーがグリシャに力を渡す理由です。理由は、自分が終わる前に後継を作る、です。作る後継が、壁の中で医者として暮らす父です。暮らす十三年のあいだに、カルラと、エレンが生まれます。生まれる家族は、使命の妨害にも、理由にもなります。なる両方を、グリシャは最後の夜まで隠します。
segments.en: A Titan's power has a term. The book suggests the term that is there as about thirteen years. The term it suggests is the reason Kruger hands the power to Grisha. The reason is to make an heir before he himself ends. The heir he makes is the father who lives as a doctor inside the walls. During the thirteen years of living, Carla and Eren are born. The family that is born becomes both an interference with the mission and a reason for it. Grisha hides both of those becomings until the last night.
